definitions: To cope with a bad situation as well as possible.
To accept an undesirable situation and try to find the positive aspects or make the most of what is available.
examples: The weather was terrible, but we decided to make the best of it and play board games indoors.
Even though the car broke down, they had to make the best of it and wait for help.
It wasn't the vacation they planned, but they made the best of it by exploring local attractions.
